extraction.Name: Victoria Lapointe Meng
extraction.Refused/Protested: No. Many years of the Indians had received theirs and I thought it too late to send it back.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold 80 acres; retained 80 acres; did not mortgage the remainder
extraction.NOTES: Has two children, ages six and three; sold 80 acres for $2000.00 cash; retained 80 acres; land appraised at $6500 for the quarter and $3500 for the remaining 80 acres; pays $93 to $97 per year in taxes; assessor appraises land too high; later bought a new car for $1300.00 from the same man; no debts settled at time of sale; no other debts against the land; received patent in mail at home; satisfied with the sale; document references 'Yisterial Victoria Lapointe Collins' as an alternate name form; subscribed and sworn April 26, 1929; document number 2878 | TASK 5 BULK ALLOTMENT RECOVERY 2026-04-29: Sonnet text-extraction captured the allotment number from the source page header but classified it in NOTES as a 'document number' / 'Document No.' / 'No. NNNN' instead of placing it in the structured Allotment number field. The hypothesis that these document/file references are actually allotment numbers was confirmed via BLM cross-reference (exemplars: Eugene Means 2249, Lucy Patton 6802). This patch corrects 49 records via bulk regex extraction from NOTES with user-supervised review of every HIGH-confidence proposal.

recovery_notes.rationale: Source page header contained 'No. NNNN' which Sonnet captured in NOTES as 'document number' rather than placing in structured Allotment field. Hypothesis confirmed via BLM cross-reference.
